title: Desperado
lrc:
[00:19.70] Desperado
[00:30.17] Why don't you come to your senses?
[00:33.37] You've been out ridin' fences for so long now
[00:38.11] Oh, you're a hard one
[00:39.58] I know that you got your reasons
[00:43.78] These things that are pleasin' you
[00:47.96] Can hurt you somehow
[00:54.08] Don't you draw the queen of diamonds, boy
[00:58.10] She'll beat you if she's able
[01:00.94] You know the queen of hearts is always your best bet
[01:09.40] Now it seems to me some fine things
[01:13.32] Have been laid upon your table
[01:16.70] But you only want the ones that you can't get
[01:25.90] Desperado
[01:28.24] Oh, you ain't gettin' no younger
[01:31.86] Your pain and your hunger
[01:36.80] They're drivin' you home
[01:41.08] Freedom, oh freedom
[01:44.84] Well, that's just some people talkin'
[01:47.64] Your prison is walkin' through this world all alone
[01:58.74] Don't your feet get cold in the wintertime?
[02:03.06] The sky won't snow and the sun won't shine
[02:07.12] It's hard to tell the nighttime from the day
[02:10.77] You're losing all your highs and lows
[02:18.72] Ain't it funny how the feeling goes away?
[02:27.79] Desperado
[02:31.73] Why don't you come to your senses?
[02:37.32] Come down from your fences
[02:41.04] Open the gate
[02:45.00] It may be rainin'
[02:47.92] But there's a rainbow above you
[02:51.81] You better let somebody love you
[02:55.94] (Let somebody love you)
[03:00.89] You better let somebody love you
[03:05.25] Before it's too late
